contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Radiate, possibly irregular, possibly of Tetricus II (271-274), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate head right, beardless. Obverse inscription: IMP[---]I C[--]. Reverse description: probably robed figure standing left. Reverse inscription: [---] AVG. Diameter: 16.5mm, Weight: 1.98gms, die axis: 12
